reason: I might try the free version on one brand DM to see if the rate it suggests makes sense, but I'm not paying for Pro or giving 5% to a small beta team when Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators. And I'm not letting a new app send payment reminders to brands from my account before I know it won't mess up a relationship I worked hard for.
objection: Influish already has the creators and the brands. What does Mitra actually get me that it doesn't, apart from saying it's in Kannada? And who is this small team, will it still be around in six months?
would_change_my_mind: If Mitra brought me actual paid collabs from local Bengaluru food places or brands that want Kannada creators, or a creator I know in South Bengaluru showed me it got her a better rate on a real deal.
